Select exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human Histone deacetylase 1 (CHEMBL325). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL325, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and standard_relation '='. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
